results.description:
Due remembers all the things that you need so you don't have to.

Because it repeatedly reminds you of things until you act on them, it‘s impossible to forget anything.

Most importantly, it's lightning-fast to set and postpone reminders, all thanks to a clever time picker and natural date parsing.


KEY FEATURES

1. Persistent & Effective
Auto Snooze repeatedly* notifies you of missed reminders until marked done or rescheduled. Choose between intervals of every 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes.

2. Fast to Set, Fast to Postpone
A time picker with 12 preset and fully customizable times lets you set due dates and postpone reminders in record time.

3. Natural Date & Time Parsing
Due can also parse dates and times that you typed or dictate and offer to set the due dates and times for you.

4. Countdown Timers
Precise to the second, perfect for making the perfect soft-boiled eggs, brewing your coffee and more. Set them up once and reuse them forever

5. Powerful Recurring Reminders
From the simple daily and weekly reminders to the complex every-3rd-Wednesday-of-the-month kind of reminders

6. Keep in Sync**
Use iCloud or Dropbox to keep your reminders and timers in sync across your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

7. Works Offline, Completely Private
There is no account to sign up for. We don't store, and we can't access your reminders and timers. And you don't need internet to receive reminders.

8. Accessible to Everyone
Automatically adjusts text size according to your system setting, and offers full VoiceOver support. Due is also localized in 17 languages.


* By default, auto snooze repeats 5 times, and can be configured to repeat up to 10 times. Due can auto snooze any overdue items indefinitely when you launch Due or act on any of its notifications.
** Sync on Mac requires Due for Mac (sold separately)


WHAT'S THAT IN-APP PURCHASE ABOUT?

When you purchase Due today, you will have access to every feature in the app today—no further purchase required.

You will also get access to all new features released one year from your date of purchase.

The optional Due Upgrade Pass subscription allows you to continue getting access to all new features released one year *after* your date of purchase.

And here's the deal: Every feature that you have unlocked will remain available to you, forever—even if you stop subscribing.

Even without a subscription, you'll always receive bug-fix and compatibility updates for free. These updates add support for the latest iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches. They also help ensure that Due continues to function well on the latest versions of iOS, iPadOS and watchOS.

Due has a pretty good track record with that.

To illustrate: If you've purchased Due back in 2010 for your iPhone 3G running iOS 4, that very same app in 2026 is now optimized for iPhone 17 Pro Max running iOS 26. It even works on devices that didn't exist back then, such as the iPad Pro and the Apple Watch.

TERMS & PRIVACY POLICY

Our terms of use and privacy policy is available here: https://www.dueapp.com/terms.html


COMPATIBILITY

Due requires an iPhone, iPod touch or iPad running iOS 16 or later. The Watch app is a companion to the iOS app. It requires watchOS 8 (or later) and the paired iPhone to work correctly.

results.releaseNotes:
New and Improved
• Reminder titles now show up to 3 lines at every text size. To show more or fewer, go to Settings › Appearance › Preview.
• The in-app sync status now appears under the list title (iOS 26 and later).
• Removed the line separators above and below a selected reminder in every theme.

Accessibility
• Improved text contrast on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
• On Apple Watch, overdue reminders and paused or overdue timers now show a symbol, not just a color, and VoiceOver reads each row as one item.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed a crash when opening Due on iOS 18.
• Fixed Due sometimes freezing when opening the calendar date picker (thanks Yusuf A.).
• Fixed tapping the buttons at the top of the reminder editor sometimes resizing the editor instead (thanks Lou G.).
• Fixed dragging the cursor in a reminder’s title accidentally triggering the swipe-to-save gesture (thanks Tony T.).
• Fixed Apple Watch sometimes showing out-of-date reminders.

---
New in Due 26.5

1. Bulk Edit Reminders
Select multiple reminders. Snooze, postpone, complete or delete. All at once. No more going through your reminders one by one.

2. All-New Apple Watch App
Due on Apple Watch has been redesigned and rebuilt from the ground up. The all-new Quick Access Times panel lets you snooze reminders as easily as you can on your iPhone.

3. Due Gets Smarter About Dates
Due now understands many more of the ways you write dates and times:

• “Meeting in 1h 20m”
• “Laundry 2.5 hours”
• “Dentist 3p Thu”

And it now reads them in every language Due speaks.

4. Control Timers with Siri
Say the name of a timer and Due starts it — no setup, no shortcut to build.

• “Hey Siri, start pasta timer in Due”
• “Pause pasta timer in Due”
• “Stop pasta timer in Due”

5. Widgets & Control Center
• All-new Lock Screen widgets. See what’s most urgent without unlocking.
• Start and pause timers, and add reminders, straight from Control Center.
• Widget text now fits at every text size.
• Long reminder names now get a second line when there is room.

6. Undo & Redo
• Undo and redo now sit on the toolbar, always within reach.
• Due keeps your undo history when you switch away and come back.

7. Refreshed and Reorganized
• Editors redesigned to match the latest look of iOS.
• Custom repeats are clearer, and quicker to set up.
• Settings is reorganized, so what you need is easier to find.
• Switch quickly between reminders, timers and logbook with the tab bar.
• Improved contrast of dates in the Ash and Light themes.

8. iOS Reminders Import
• A redesigned import screen shows your Reminders lists in their own colors, with notes, priority and repeats at a glance.
• Give undated reminders a due date as you import them.
• See unsupported reminders before you import.

9. Siri & Shortcuts
• Add reminders to Due with the new Siri in iOS 27.
• Filter and sort reminders by date created and last changed.

10. Bug Fixes
• Fixed an occasional crash while searching.
• Fixed changes to a title being lost when tapping “Keep” after a date is parsed.
• Fixed a repeating reminder sometimes skipping its next occurrence after editing it.
• Fixed a crash when opening Sounds & Alerts without having allowed notifications.
• VoiceOver now names the correct alert type in the reminder and timer editors.
• Fixed notification titles and iPad card buttons sitting too close to the rounder corners in iOS 26 and later.

11. Become a Supporter
Some of you have asked how to support Due further. You can now leave a tip in Settings › Become a Supporter. It doesn’t unlock anything; it simply helps keep Due going. Thank you.

12. Requirements
Due 26.5 requires iOS 18 or later.
results.description:

And it's lightning-fast to set and postpone reminders, all thanks to a clever time picker and natural date parsing.

1. Persistent & Effective
Auto Snooze* keeps nudging you about a missed reminder until you mark it done or reschedule it. Choose between every 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes.

2. Impossible to Miss
Some reminders can't wait. Use Critical Alerts to get through silent mode and Focus. Or use Prominent Alerts†, which ring like an alarm until you act.

3. Fast to Set, Fast to Postpone
Keep the times you use most a tap away. Twelve Quick Access Times—all fully customizable—make setting or postponing reminders a piece of cake.

4. Just Type or Say It
Type or say “Dentist 3p Thu” or “Meeting in 1h 20m”. Due spots the date, and one tap sets it.

5. Powerful Recurring Reminders
From simple daily reminders to the every-3rd-Wednesday-of-the-month kind, Due keeps up with your routine.

6. Countdown Timers
Not every reminder happens at a time of day. Some happen when the laundry cycle is done. That's what timers are for: precise to the second, with Auto Snooze too. Or just say “Hey Siri, start Laundry timer in Due”.

7. On Your Apple Watch
Wear an Apple Watch? Due comes with you. Mark reminders done, snooze them, add new ones, start and stop timers—all from your wrist. It's a companion to Due on iPhone, so keep your iPhone nearby.

8. Widgets, Control Center & Shortcuts
See what's coming up on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Start timers and add reminders from Control Center, and automate the rest with Shortcuts.

9. Everywhere You Are
Your reminders and timers on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac‡, all kept in sync with iCloud or Dropbox.

10. No Account, Completely Private
There's no account to sign up for. We don't store, and we can't access, your reminders and timers. And you don't need internet to receive reminders.

11. Accessible to Everyone
Due follows the text size you set on your device, on every screen, and offers full VoiceOver support. It's also localized in 17 languages.

† Prominent Alerts require iOS 26 or later.
‡ Sync on Mac requires Due for Mac (sold separately).

And here's the deal: Every feature that you have unlocked will remain available to you, forever—even if you stop subscribing.

Even without a subscription, you'll always receive bug-fix and compatibility updates for free. These updates add support for the latest iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches, and keep Due working well on the latest versions of iOS, iPadOS and watchOS.

Due has a pretty good track record with that.

To illustrate: If you bought Due back in 2010 for your iPhone 3G running iOS 4, that very same app in 2026 is now optimized for iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27. It even works on devices that didn't exist back then, such as the iPad Pro and the Apple Watch.
